title: C. Baroumis, N. Zannos, Dr. Spurgatis, E. P. Yannoulatos

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
S.2. Special Branch.
REPORT

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE File REGISTRY No D H 8503 Date 24/5/33）
Date May 23, 1933.

Subject (in full) C. Baroumis.

Made by D.S.Tcheremshansky. Forwarded by （签名）

With reference to the memo of the Officer i/c Special
Branch of May 8, 1933, on the subject of C. Baroumis, enquiries
show that this individual is a Greek aged about 63 years,
single and poorly educated. He arrived in China about 20 years
ago and was formerly engaged in commercial activities. A
few years ago Baroumis inherited from his brother one Nikolas
Baroumis, the "Niagara Mineral Water Company", French
Concession, Hankow, and since that time has permanently
resided in Hankow.

Baroumis is known to be suffering from some serious
disease, and recently arrived in Shanghai to undergo an
operation. He resides at present at No.19 Route Vallon, the
house of one N. Zannos, a former employee of the Public
Works Department of the French Municipal Council. The wife
of N. Zannos is the niece of Baroumis. Baroumis visited
Russia during the Great War in 191b (?) in connection with
certain transactions in tobacco.

Baroumis who speaks Russian fairly well is a well
respected member of local Greek community, and also the
"Hellenic Communal Association", 36 Jinkee Road. He is not
known to be connected and/or interested in political activities.

During the early part of 1932 Dr. Spurgatis
resident of Peking was appointed Greek Consul-General for
China and Mr. E.P. Yannoulatos, former Chairman of the local
"Hellenic Communal Association", Greek Consul in Shanghai.
These appointments were later published in the newspapers in
Greece. However, prior to the Chinese government receiving
any official notification from Greece, certain local Greek
residents, believed to be personal enemies of Yannoulatos,

报告

（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处 档案登记号 D H 8503 日期 33年5月24日）
日期：1933年5月23日。

主题（全称） C. Baroumis。

制作人 D.S.Tcheremshansky。转呈人 （签名）

参照特别股主管于1933年5月8日关于C. Baroumis一事的备忘录，经查询显示，此人为希腊籍，年龄约63岁，未婚，受教育程度低。他约在20年前抵达中国，此前从事商业活动。几年前，Baroumis从其兄弟Nikolas Baroumis处继承了位于汉口法租界的“尼亚加拉矿泉水公司”（Niagara Mineral Water Company），自此便长期居住于汉口。

据悉Baroumis患有某种严重疾病，近期抵沪接受手术。他目前居住在瓦隆路（Route Vallon）19号，即前法国公董局工务处雇员N. Zannos的寓所。N. Zannos之妻系Baroumis的侄女。Baroumis曾在191b(?)年大战期间因某些烟草交易事宜访问过俄国。

Baroumis俄语说得相当好，是当地希腊社区以及金吉路36号“希腊社区协会”（Hellenic Communal Association）中受尊敬的成员。据知他与政治活动无关且对此不感兴趣。

1932年初，居住于北平的Spurgatis博士被任命为希腊驻华中总领事，当地“希腊社区协会”前主席E.P. Yannoulatos先生被任命为希腊驻上海领事。这些任命后来在希腊的报纸上刊登。然而，在中国政府收到来自希腊的任何正式通知之前，某些被认为是Yannoulatos个人仇敌的当地希腊居民，

sent a letter to the Nanking Government accusing him of
harbouring pro-Japanese leanings. The result of this letter
was that the Chinese government upon receipt of the request
of the Greek Government objected to the appointment of
Yannoulatos as Greek Consul in Shanghai mainly on the strength
of the report they had received.

E.P. Yannoulatos, who has resided in China for about
20 years, has a good reputation and is the proprietor of the
"Yannoulatos Bros. (China)", Silk, Lace, Embroidery and China
Produce, No. 36 Jinkee Road. When it was discovered that
a letter had been sent to Nanking, Yannoulatos and certain
members of the local Greek community sent a despatch with to the
Chinese and Greek governments explaining the true facts of the
case and that the allegations were false. It was also
mentioned that Yannoulatos had received a decoration from
the Chinese government for "Good work for China" and therefore
could hardly be called an enemy of this country.

The question of the appointment of Yannoulatos has
not yet been settled.

Regarding the accusation against Baroumis that he is
a political intriguer, it is strongly suspected that this
information emanated from the same source as that which
accused Yannoulatos.

G. Tcheremshanoff
D. S.

Supt. Ian,

向南京政府发送了一封信，指控他 harboring pro-Japanese leanings（怀有亲日倾向）。这封信的结果是，中国政府在收到希腊政府的请求后，主要依据其所收到的报告，反对任命Yannoulatos为希腊驻上海领事。

E.P. Yannoulatos在华居住约20年，声誉良好，是位于金吉路36号的“Yannoulatos兄弟（中国）公司”（Yannoulatos Bros. (China)）的业主，经营丝绸、蕾丝、刺绣及中国土产。当发现有一封信寄往南京后，Yannoulatos及当地希腊社区的某些成员向中国和希腊政府发送了一份电报，解释了案件的真实情况，并指出这些指控是虚假的。电报中还提到，Yannoulatos曾因“对华有益工作”获得中国政府颁发的勋章，因此很难称其为该国的敌人。

关于Yannoulatos的任命问题尚未解决。

关于指控Baroumis是政治阴谋家一事，强烈怀疑这一情报来源与指控Yannoulatos的来源相同。

G. Tcheremshanoff
D. S.
